name: NY-25
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by about 10 points on the PVI
Incumbent Joseph Morelle has a large fundraising edge ($1.8M vs $32K)
No outside spending against Morelle and no general-election polling
model.rationale: Morelle combines a Democratic-leaning seat, incumbency, and an overwhelming financial advantage against a barely funded challenger, with markets pricing the race near certain. The fundamentals support a Safe D rating with a margin in the low twenties.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending against Morelle would be the first sign the race is closer than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Joseph Morelle, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a Rochester-area district that leans Democratic by about ten points. He has raised roughly $1.8 million and holds over $400,000 on hand, while Republican Virginia McIntyre has raised about $32,000 with little cash remaining. No outside groups are spending against Morelle, and no general-election polls have been conducted in the race.

Prediction markets price Morelle's chances near 97 percent. With no expert ratings or polling available, the forecast rests on the district's partisan lean, incumbency, and the stark resource gap, all of which point to a comfortable Democratic win in the low-twenties margin range.
